permissions.//: DB tooling allowlist — connection-string + CLI workflow (replaces MCP permission prompts). psql:* runs any SQL incl. DDL without prompting; narrow it if you want review-before-apply. `supabase db push` and `db reset` are intentionally NOT listed so they still prompt.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && v=$(grep -rlE 'package:(flutter|flutter_riverpod|riverpod_annotation|supabase_flutter|supabase|drift|go_router|dio|http)/' lib/features/*/domain 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$v" ]; then echo "ARCHITECTURE VIOLATION - framework import in a pure-Dart domain layer (CLAUDE.md Rule 1). Offending files: $v" >&2; exit 2; fi
